scope: GET settings and read-only SQL only

legacy_policies.name: families_select_for_members
legacy_policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM family_memberships fm
  WHERE ((fm.family_id = families.id) AND (fm.user_id = auth.uid()))))

legacy_policies.name: families_update_for_admins
legacy_policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM family_memberships fm
  WHERE ((fm.family_id = families.id) AND (fm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (fm.role = 'admin'::text))))

legacy_policies.name: memberships_select_own_or_same_family
legacy_policies.using:
((user_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM family_memberships fm
  WHERE ((fm.family_id = family_memberships.family_id) AND (fm.user_id = auth.uid())))))
